text:
olivia: quick sync — we need alignment on launch windows for H200 / MI300 / Gaudi across marketplace + SI partners. who owns press embargo slots? any hard dates from HW vendors? :calendar:

diego: vendor PRs tentatively target: H200 week of May 18, MI300 week of June 8, Gaudi early July. vendors still finalizing exact days.

eve_marketing: ok — for press we need at least 2x options per vendor (AM / PM) and an embargo lead time of 72hrs. can we lock windows by EOD thursday?

ken_infra: from an engineering readiness POV: H200 cert run + perf bench completes May 10, MI300 perf on our infra target May 28, Gaudi lab image and SI test harness ready June 15. potential risk: supply lab capacity May 12-16.

olivia: good — Sam, can you coordinate SI readiness with partners and confirm if they can meet those lab windows?

sam_partners: on it. pinged three leads (Tomas at SI-One, Priya at Integrates, Marco at EdgeSys). will push for firm yes/no by Tue.

press-bot: Reminder: draft embargo template available at https://redwood-internal/docs/embargo-template. Please attach PR drafts to the doc 48hrs before embargo.

eve_marketing: also need final keynote slide deck for marketplace announcement. Ken — can you confirm perf numbers we can ship to marketing?

ken_infra: current numbers (rough): H200 60 qps steady for our 2k token LLM profile, MI300 45 qps, Gaudi 30 qps. still iterating quant profiles.

olivia: that helps. flag: B200 availability might slip — vendor warned of staggered shipments. if B200 delayed, do we fallback to H200-only messaging?

diego: yes — fallback plan: primary announcement will call out multi-vendor support, but we’ll only name GA vendors that have confirmed shipments. draft fallback language here: https://redwood-internal/announcements/drafts

sam_partners: SI checklist (high-level):
```
- Confirm vendor hardware delivery dates to SI (owner: SI lead)
- Run CI bench on SI infra (owner: Redwood eng)
- Validate marketplace image + AMI/container tags (owner: infra)
- Perform SI dry-run of deployment and smoke tests (owner: SI partner)
- Lock embargo window & PR assets (owner: marketing)
```

olivia: perfect. add a line for KMS/HSM compliance if any partner is in regulated sector.

sam_partners: added.

eve_marketing: timeline ask: marketing needs final hero perf, 5 screenshots, and customer quote by May 20 for H200 wave. can engs commit?

ken_infra: screenshots + hero perf for H200 by May 12 if lab capacity holds. otherwise May 20.

olivia: action items:
- sam_partners: confirm SI leads availability and hardware receipts by Tue (owner: sam_partners)
- ken_infra: prioritize H200 cert runs and deliver hero perf assets by May 12 if possible (owner: ken_infra)
- eve_marketing: prepare embargo template + PR timeline; need drafts 48hrs before lock (owner: eve_marketing)
- diego: maintain fallback comms and vendor messaging (owner: diego)

sam_partners: scheduling quick follow-up: 30m sync Thursday 10am PT to lock windows. invite sent.

olivia: thanks everyone. if any vendor updates (embargo changes, shipments), drop in this thread and tag @olivia. :thumbsup:

diego: tagging vendor-ops to watch for updates.

ken_infra: FYI I’ll post final perf CSVs to the shared drive when runs complete.

eve_marketing: will prep press timeline with two backup dates.

olivia: wrap — good momentum.
